title: ZPA Terraform provider configuration: no-credential mode, authentication framework, clouds and rate limits

prose.text: The ZPA provider authenticates with OneAPI by default and with the legacy ZPA framework on request, and has an inert mode for configurations that never call the API. {{api-parity-only}}

prose.label: Precedence with the environment variable.
prose.text: {{skip-flag-env-fallback}} Whether an explicit false defeats the environment variable is open {{gap:getok-false-reads-as-unset}}.
Credential and secret handling is covered in [[shared.terraform.credential-handling]]; the equivalent ZIA modes are in [[zia.terraform.provider-modes]].

parallelism-deprecated-ignored.statement: The provider's parallelism attribute is deprecated, has no effect, and is to be removed in a future major release.

quotes: Deprecated and ignored. Previously limited the number of concurrent API requests.
This attribute no longer has any effect and will be removed in a future major release.

rate-limit-retry-after.statement: Rate limits are handled by the provider: it honours the Retry-After header returned on a 429 response and retries transparently.

quotes: the provider honours the Retry-After header returned on a 429 response and retries transparently.

fedramp-oneapi-4-4-6.statement: OneAPI reaches the government (FedRAMP) clouds through zscaler_cloud (or ZSCALER_CLOUD) set to gov or govus, and the provider documents this as supported only from v4.4.6; earlier versions are not supported.

quotes: Supported Zidentity Gov Cloud `gov` or `govus`
FedRAMP cloud is only supported when upgrading to the provider version `>=v4.4.6`. Earlier versions are NOT supported.
To authenticate, set the `cloud` attribute (or `ZSCALER_CLOUD` environment variable) to one of the supported government values:

commercial-cloud-optional.statement: zscaler_cloud is optional for production commercial clouds and only required for other environments; the documented values are beta for the test commercial cloud and gov or govus for FedRAMP.

quotes: The `zscaler_cloud` is optional for production comercial Clouds and ONLY required when authenticating to other environments.
- Test (Beta) Commercial Clouds: `beta`
- Production Commericial Clouds: The cloud parameter `IS NOT` required.
- FedRAMP Clouds: `gov` or `govus`

credential-env-vars.statement: The provider docs say OneAPI credentials can be supplied through ZSCALER_CLIENT_ID, ZSCALER_CLIENT_SECRET, ZSCALER_VANITY_DOMAIN and ZSCALER_CLOUD, with customer_id from ZPA_CUSTOMER_ID, and legacy credentials through ZPA_CLIENT_ID, ZPA_CLIENT_SECRET, ZPA_CUSTOMER_ID and ZPA_CLOUD. They also name ZSCALER_PRIVATE_KEY for private_key, which conflicts with client_secret, and ZSCALER_HTTP_PROXY for http_proxy. The provider's config code, not the schema, reads these ZSCALER_* variables when the matching attribute is empty.

Can also be sourced from the `ZPA_CUSTOMER_ID` environment variable. It is required when interacting with ZPA Cloud via OneAPI framework.

retry-tuning-4-4-12.statement: Provider v4.4.12 deprecated the backoff, min_wait_seconds and max_wait_seconds attributes, which are now ignored; the documented defaults are 100 for max_retries, which is also its maximum, and 240 seconds for request_timeout, where 0 selects the SDK's built-in 60-second timeout.

quotes: Deprecated the provider attributes `backoff`, `min_wait_seconds`, and `max_wait_seconds`. They are now ignored and will be removed in a future major release
Default and maximum: `100`.
Default: `240`. Accepted values: `0`-`300`, where `0` selects the SDK's built-in 60-second timeout.
`max_retries` - (Optional) Maximum number of times a rate-limited or transiently failing request is retried before the operation fails.
`request_timeout` - (Optional) Timeout in seconds for a single HTTP request to the ZPA API.

api-parity-only.statement: The provider implements only the features the public ZPA API exposes, so a feature in the Admin Console may be missing from the provider without the provider lagging.

quotes: certain features or attributes available via the Zscaler UI may not be immediately available through the API
we implement only the features that are currently exposed by the public API.
This does not indicate that the provider is lagging behind

getok-false-reads-as-unset.title: Whether an explicit skip_credentials_validation = false overrides ZSCALER_SKIP_CREDENTIALS_VALIDATION=true
getok-false-reads-as-unset.blocks: knowing whether setting the attribute to false is enough to switch off an inherited environment variable
getok-false-reads-as-unset.detail: Unverified legacy statement: the legacy reference says Terraform Plugin SDK v2.40.1 GetOk treats the boolean false as not set, so an explicit false does not override the environment variable and the inert mode turns on. The provider code path (GetOk, then the environment variable) is shown, but the Plugin SDK source is not a registered source and the focused provider tests cover only explicit true, environment true and missing credentials.
